text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh! Thank you so much, Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nhihi. Today, believe it or not! The 
genius me! Prepared the most awesomely 
genius birthday cooking present ever~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A whole roasted chicken! Let's celebrate 
big and flashy!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Pandora-san made a home-cooked 
meal especially for me...?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, once in a while, right? Ai-chan's 
helped me out before too.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I put it in the oven a while ago, so it 
should be done right about now, don'tcha 
think? So let's go, let's go! Ritto is 
fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank—wait, what? You didn't check 
how well-done it is!?!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What? You pretty much just leave it 
alone, right? It's an oven, after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Ack, oven or not, I've really got to keep 
a close eye on these things and check 
often!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The browning might be uneven... Anyway, 
let's go check on it! Hurry, hurry!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Ai-chan, you'll look over it for me? 
What a lifesaver~♡
